message:
Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the single electrical total now decides holding and supersedes the mixed totals. In plain words cooling heat is not wire power until divided by efficiency. Thermal total 13.5 kilowatt-hour thermal per day from the single thermal total (E109) as conduction 4.87 plus respiration 1.20 plus door 0.169 plus pull-down 6.25 plus fans 0.96 converts by Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) 1.40 plus controls to 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day from the reconciled electrical total (E111) confirmed in the term-by-term check (E128), which supersedes 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day from the steady plus staged estimate (E58), against yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day from the grown-array yield calc (E83) leaving about 3.10 kilowatt-hour margin, about one-third of a household day so everyday scale holds, with night plus one cloudy day carried by 10.0 kilowatt-hour usable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4, rechargeable battery chemistry) ending at 3.73 kilowatt-hour in the battery autonomy simulation (E95) with 75.0 ampere charge in the charge current calc (E97).

Enclosure and Structural Designer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, the chamber feet now carry only chamber weight on a separated path with wind tied down. In plain words car weight on six feet stays below soft soil while the distant field frame goes to its own feet. Complete 2210 kilogram from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) as produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus frames plus modules plus wiring separates to chamber 1930 kilogram from the chamber-only mass sum (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal from the chamber-only pad pressure (E127) and 28.5 kilopascal with foundations, which supersedes 19.8 kilopascal from the chamber structure pressure (E119) as the controlling chamber value, still below 150 kilopascal soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet (E62), about one person standing so everyday scale holds, with 673 kilogram uplift from the wind uplift equivalent (E90) on 17.6 square metres from the nine-module footprint (E84) held by 1390 kilogram from eight anchors in the anchor hold calculation (E123), with crate layout from the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124).

Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, Solar Energy Systems Engineer, the tonne count with door discipline is now the operating limit tied to the energy number. In plain words fifty boxes over four mornings with eight quick openings is allowed and more is refused. Holding is 1000 kilogram from the total produce mass estimate (E49) as 50 crates from the crates check (E77) staged 12.5 per day from the daily crates intake (E78), through 900 millimetre door with 8 openings at 0.169 kilowatt-hour per day from the single door model (E110) superseding 0.440 kilowatt-hour per day from the door infiltration estimate (E57), with full-tonne 25.0 kilowatt-hour from the recomputed pull-down estimate (E26) refused by rule and 43 degree pull-down plus field pull test named as bench tests needing built hardware, not blocks.

RECORD: Decided are grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control as version three superseding version two chamber pressure; numbers that stand are 1000 kilogram (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against controlling 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day (E111) from thermal 13.5 (E109) with door 0.169 (E110) by COP 1.40, chamber 1930 kilogram (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal (E127) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with complete 2210 kilogram (E118) and 1390 kilogram hold against 673 kilogram uplift, 17.6 square metre split 2 plus 7 (E84); still open are member votes on version three and field pull plus 43 degree bench tests owed to test team.
Note on Solar Energy Systems Engineer: confirmed thermal to electrical conversion with autonomy and surge on shared ids.
Note on Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer: single thermal total with curtain door and serviceable refrigerant closed the chain.
Note on Enclosure and Structural Designer: separated chamber pressure with quantified anchorage and dimensioned layout closed support.
Note on Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist: enforceable tonne plus eight-opening refusal rule tied operation to energy.
My position is not ready to close, because version three with the separated controlling pressure needs your votes though design logic is ready.
